english.title: Worker knowingly sell alcohol to drunk on relevant licensed premises
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), while working at relevant premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), in a capacity which authorised you to sell alcohol, knowingly sold alcohol on those premises to a person who was drunk
english.legislation: Contrary to section 141(1)(a), (2)(a) and (4) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

knowingly sold alcohol

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DA16

(i) The Penalty Notice for Disorder was raised from £80 to £90 as from 01/07/13.
(ii) Fingerprints, photographs and DNA samples may be taken from an individual where he/she is subject to arrest and the Penalty Notice is issued at a police station.
